raw.title: Engineering Manager - Platform and Data Intelligence
raw.description:
Engineering Manager - Platform and Data Intelligence

 
 

About trawa

 

European energy costs are 2x compared to US and China. Electricity demand is expected to double by 2050. Market price volatility & complexity are here to stay. The backbone of Europe's industrial economy is at risk and companies need to act now.

trawa is building the solution: the first integrated B2B energy platform that orchestrates procurement, energy management, and flexibility steering in one product. Supply, Manage, and Flex combined. That integration unlocks up to 30% in recurring electricity cost savings, all while helping companies switch to renewable energy.

We're the fastest-growing B2B energy platform in Europe. Active in Germany and Austria now, and expanding operations to a third market in 2027. We're on the road to European scale and move fast, the market window is open and we intend to own it.

trawa is a scale-up based in Berlin with ~100 FTE, ~30 of whom work in Product & Tech. We've raised over €35M to date, including a €24M Series A in May 2025, backed by Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic, and Tiny VC. All three founders are on board and 100% committed to build the utility of the future.

 
 
 

About the Role

 

We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead two teams that form the foundation everything at trawa runs on: Data Intelligence and Platform.

Data is the heartbeat of trawa. It turns the complexity of energy markets into savings and sustainability for our customers. Underneath it sits the cloud infrastructure powering our services and the IT and security practices that keep our systems and data safe. You’ll own the technical direction for all of it, from metering data management and billing to AWS infrastructure and internal IT.

You’ll shape a team culture grounded in trust, collaboration, and continuous learning, where engineers thrive and do their best work. You’ll report to the Director of Engineering and lead an established, growing group of engineers across two closely related teams.

At trawa, our culture is “office-first with flexibility”: most of us are in our Berlin office the majority of the week, with room to work from home when needed. The Tech team follows a more hybrid rhythm, with a minimum of 3 days a week in the office.

 
 

What You'll Do

 

Own the roadmap for our central data warehouse and the data platform our products are built on

  • Build a scalable data backend for the core processes of an energy provider, including timeseries data management, invoicing, and billing

  • Lead the design and operation of critical data pipelines, data quality standards, and observability practices

  • Run scalable, secure, highly available infrastructure on AWS for our mission-critical services

  • Drive great developer experience through CI/CD, observability tooling, and internal platforms that help teams ship faster and with confidence

  • Own IT operations and security: the tools, processes, and policies that keep trawa’s systems and data safe

Our tech stack

  • AWS, Terraform, Docker, GitHub Actions

  • Postgres, ClickHouse, dbt, Metabase

  • Python (pandas, polars), TypeScript

  • Dash0, Sentry, incident.io

  • Primo

 
 
 

Your First 90 Days

 

First 6 weeks (onboarding)

  • Build strong relationships with your direct reports, peers, and stakeholders

  • Understand each team’s current OKRs and how they impact the company

  • Get a solid understanding of our data architecture, infrastructure, and security posture

By month 3 (ramp-up)

  • Review operational health and tech debt across both teams, and present a prioritized plan for improvements in observability, data health, and scalability

  • Define and share a clear vision and roadmap for Data Intelligence and Platform, including how we improve developer experience

  • Assess our IT operations and security practices, and plan how they scale with trawa’s growth

  • Align next quarter’s roadmap with stakeholders and company OKRs, and communicate it broadly

 

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years in a technical leadership role with people management responsibilities, ideally in a fast-moving startup. You’ve led across multiple teams and know how to balance competing priorities.

  • Deep hands-on background in data platform/data engineering or platform engineering/SRE/DevOps, and solid working knowledge of the other

  • Strong AWS experience: infrastructure as code, cloud-native patterns, containerized systems, with a good grasp of security, reliability, observability, and cost efficiency

  • Clear communicator who builds trust across teams and with non-technical stakeholders

  • Inclusive leader who creates an environment where engineers of diverse backgrounds can thrive

Don’t meet every single requirement? We still encourage you to apply!

At trawa, we’re dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply – you may be the right fit for this or another opportunity.

 
 
 

Why Join Us

 

🌍 Real impact - At trawa, you will be part of a team that is dedicated to making a positive impact on the world. We value creativity, collaboration, and diverse perspectives.

 

🚀 Early ownership - We empower our team members to take ownership of their work and drive results, regardless of background or experience level.

 

🤝 Mentorship that matters - Regular leadership sessions, cross-functional exposure, and engineers who are genuinely invested in your growth.

 

📚 Learning culture - We provide an annual budget and dedicated time for professional development. You’ll have opportunities for mentorship, learning, and career progression.

 

🌐 Inclusive by design - We’re an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects that. Our tech organisation brings together over 15 nationalities, contributing a variety of languages, experiences, and perspectives. At trawa, we’re family-friendly with parents across all levels, and our diversity is represented throughout the company, including leadership. We’re committed to an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

 

🎁 Solid benefits - We offer a competitive compensation package including salary and stock options, 30 days of vacation, and a range of benefits including subsidies for home internet and lunches, a Sports Club membership, a productivity budget for work essentials (e.g., headphones, monitor), dedicated learning days with an annual learning budget, plus a weekly team lunch and regular team events.

Country sales teams will retain account ownership, opportunity management and revenue responsibility, while you define the Enterprise strategy, customer propositions, industry points of view, sales plays and adoption mechanisms that enable them to win and grow strategic Enterprise customers.</p> <p>You will work closely with Field Sales, Product, Field Engineering, Product and Field Marketing, partners and customers to build a differentiated Enterprise narrative and translate it into repeatable field execution. You will also build and lead a team of Enterprise Business Development Managers aligned to priority vertical industries, bringing deep expertise in how AI will reshape those sectors.</p> title: Principal Consultant (Enterprise Modernisation Architect)
description: <div class="description content"> <p>The Solution architect for Enterprise Modernization in Europe is a senior subject matter expert responsible for technical excellence, solution integrity, and capability development within the service line.</p> <p>This hands-on role leads high-impact client engagements, contributes to pre-sales and solution design, and ensures the regional adoption and evolution of service-specific delivery frameworks, tools, and best practices. The role brings deep expertise in modernization strategies and execution in large legacy systems modernization programs, serving as a trusted technical advisor to both clients and internal teams. This role is key to ensuring delivery quality, enabling service adoption, and evolving the technical maturity of the offering.</p> </div> <h2 id="job-responsibilities">Job responsibilities</h2> <div class="job-responsibilities content"> <ul> <li>Provides technical guidance on Enterprise Systems Modernization.</li> <li>Supports delivery teams in solving complex client problems.</li> <li>Contributes to solution design, proposals, and pre-sales activities.</li> <li>Develops and refines service accelerators and reference architectures.</li> <li>Mentors engineers and architects within the service domain.</li> <li>Acts as a bridge between delivery teams and global service development.</li> <li>Measures success by technical quality, asset adoption, and talent uplift.</li> <li>Requires 10+ years of experience in software engineering or technical consulting.</li> <li>Requires 3+ years in Enterprise Systems Modernization advisory.</li> <li>Focuses on technical depth in modernization strategies and enterprise solution architecture.</li> </ul> </div> <h2 id="job-qualifications">Job qualifications</h2> <div class="job-qualifications content"> <h3 id="technical-skills">Technical Skills</h3> <br> <div class="qualifications inner-content"> <ul> <li>Experience supporting solution design and technical delivery in complex enterprise environments.</li> <li>Proven ability to build, extend, and support delivery tools, frameworks, and reusable assets.</li> <li>Deep technical expertise in modernization strategies, cloud architecture, and platform thinking.</li> <li>Strong engineering skills, architecture patterns knowledge, and toolchain understanding.</li> <li>Excellent communication to translate technical insights into actionable business decisions.</li> <li>Collaborative with mentorship abilities and solution-oriented with asset contribution commitment.</li> </ul> </div> <h3 id="professional-skills">Professional Skills</h3> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; <div class="skills inner-content"> <ul> <li>10+ years in software engineering, platform delivery, or technical consulting roles.</li> <li>3+ years in a subject matter expert or senior technical advisory role within Enterprise Systems Modernization.</li> <li>Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.</li> <li>Certifications in relevant platforms, tools, or frameworks for the Enterprise Systems Modernization domain.</li> <li>Experience contributing to internal accelerators, open-source projects, or client-aligned IP development.</li> <li>Familiarity with enterprise transformation programs and the consulting delivery lifecycle.</li> </ul> </div> </div> <h2 id="important-things">Other things to know</h2> <div class="important-things content"> <h3>Learning &amp; Development</h3> <div class="inner-content"> <p>There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.</p> </div> </div> <h2 id="responsible-ai-use">Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment</h2> <div class="responsible-ai-use content"> <p>At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.<br><br>Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.<br><br>We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full <a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/careers/ai-policy-for-recruitment" target="_blank">Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment</a>.</p> </div> <h2 id="about">About Thoughtworks</h2> <div class="about content"> <p>Thoughtworks is a dynamic and inclusive community of bright and supportive colleagues who are revolutionizing tech. As a leading technology consultancy, we’re pushing boundaries through our purposeful and impactful work. description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at&nbsp;<a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><h2>What You’ll Do:</h2> <p>The Southern Europe Sales organization is responsible for establishing CoreWeave as the preferred AI cloud platform for enterprises, AI labs, digital-native companies, and emerging AI builders across France, Italy, Iberia, and the wider Mediterranean region. The team creates new markets, develops strategic customer relationships, and helps customers use CoreWeave’s infrastructure and software platform to build, deploy, and scale the next generation of AI.</p> <p><strong>About the role: </strong>The Senior Director of Sales, Southern Europe reports to the VP and Managing Director of EMEA. As the senior sales leader for the region, you will own CoreWeave’s commercial strategy and execution across all customer segments, with responsibility for both new-logo acquisition and the growth of existing customers. You will inherit an established customer base and a team spanning Account Executives, Account Managers, and Account Solutions Architects, while carrying a significant mandate to design and build the broader regional coverage model. This is a hands-on, first-on-the-ground leadership role for someone who can build the business, recruit and develop exceptional talent, and support market growth in coordination with EMEA leadership, and personally lead the region’s most strategic customer opportunities.</p> <ul> <li>Own the Southern Europe business, including regional strategy, revenue performance, consumption growth, pipeline creation, customer acquisition, retention, and expansion.</li> <li>Develop and execute a multi-year market-capture plan across France, Italy, Iberia, and the wider Mediterranean region, aligned to CoreWeave’s EMEA and global priorities.</li> <li>Design the regional segmentation, territory, account, and coverage model across Enterprise, AI Labs, Digital Natives, and Startup customers.</li> <li>Build and scale the regional sales organization, recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing leaders and individual contributors as the business grows.</li> <li>Lead, coach, and develop Account Executives and Account Managers, establishing clear expectations, strong inspection disciplines, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Partner closely with Account Solutions Architects to connect customer business objectives with CoreWeave’s infrastructure, platform, and developer capabilities.</li> <li>Personally develop relationships with senior executives, founders, technical leaders, and strategic stakeholders across the region.</li> <li>Lead from the front on the region’s most strategic opportunities, remaining actively involved from initial engagement through solution development, commercial negotiation, and closure, with final contracting execution by EMEA/HQ.</li> <li>Own the acquisition of new strategic customers while developing account strategies that increase adoption, consumption, retention, and long-term customer value across the existing customer base.</li> <li>Build a high-quality, appropriately covered pipeline and establish a consistent operating cadence for opportunity inspection, account planning, forecasting, risk management, and corrective action.</li> <li>Deliver accurate and transparent forecasts, with clear visibility into customer demand, consumption, commercial risk, capacity requirements, and execution dependencies.</li> <li>Develop and close, subject to HQ review and execution, complex, high-value, multi-year commercial agreements, including strategic capacity commitments and enterprise-wide platform relationships.</li> <li>Drive adoption of CoreWeave’s broader platform and software capabilities, ensuring customers see CoreWeave as a strategic technology partner rather than solely an infrastructure provider.</li> <li>Partner across Field Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success, Capacity, Product, Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, and executive leadership to deliver coordinated customer outcomes.</li> <li>Support CoreWeave’s partner, venture capital, startup ecosystem, sovereign AI, and government-relations strategies across the region.</li> <li>Represent regional customer requirements and market dynamics within CoreWeave, ensuring that global product, capacity, investment, and go-to-market decisions reflect the opportunities and needs of Southern Europe.</li> <li>Establish CoreWeave’s reputation in the region through active participation in the AI, technology, business, research, and investment communities.</li> <li>Build a regional culture that reflects CoreWeave’s values, rewards ownership, develops talent, encourages collaboration, and delivers best-in-class customer experiences.</li> </ul> <h2>Who You Are:</h2> <ul> <li>15+ years of experience in enterprise technology sales, including significant experience selling cloud infrastructure, AI platforms, data platforms, enterprise software, or similarly complex technology solutions.</li> <li>8+ years of sales leadership experience, including responsibility for senior sellers, managers, or multi-country commercial teams.</li> <li>Demonstrated success building or materially scaling a country, regional, or multi-market sales organization.</li> <li>A consistent record of meeting or exceeding significant revenue, bookings, consumption, pipeline, and customer-growth objectives.</li> <li>Experience leading both new-logo acquisition and the expansion of complex, strategic customer relationships.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to develop and close high-value, multi-year agreements involving senior executives, technical stakeholders, procurement teams, legal teams, and other complex buying groups.</li> <li>Experience selling into multiple customer segments, ideally including large enterprises, high-growth technology companies, AI-native businesses, research organizations, and startups.</li> <li>Experience designing segmentation, account allocation, territory, coverage, hiring, and resource-investment models.</li> <li>Strong command of enterprise sales methodologies, account planning, opportunity management, pipeline inspection, forecasting, and performance management.</li> <li>Proven ability to recruit, coach, and develop high-performing sales talent, including leaders and senior individual contributors.</li> <li>The ability to engage credibly with both commercial and deeply technical audiences, translating customer objectives into infrastructure and platform strategies.</li> <li>Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience structuring complex agreements and balancing customer requirements with capacity, risk, margin, and long-term strategic value.</li> <li>A hands-on leadership style and willingness to remain personally involved in strategic selling, executive engagement, and critical negotiations.</li> <li>Proven ability to operate effectively within a fast-growing, globally matrixed organization and align regional execution with global priorities.</li> <li>Fluent English and French language skills.</li> <li>The ability to travel frequently across the region and internationally as required.</li> </ul> <h2>Preferred:</h2> <ul> <li>Leadership experience within an AI cloud, hyperscale cloud, infrastructure, enterprise platform, or consumption-based technology company.</li> <li>Experience building a new region or significantly expanding an early-stage market presence.</li> <li>Experience selling GPU infrastructure, accelerated computing, machine learning platforms, developer tools, or large-scale data and AI solutions.</li> <li>Experience managing commercial opportunities where customer commitments depend on capacity availability, infrastructure deployment, supply, or service readiness.</li> <li>Experience engaging with founders, research organizations, venture capital firms, sovereign entities, or national AI initiatives.</li> <li>Spanish or Italian language skills.</li> <li>An established executive and technology network across Southern Europe.</li> <li>A bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> <h2>Wondering if you’re a good fit?</h2> <p>We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.</p> <ul> <li>You are a builder who is energized by the opportunity to create a market, design an organization, and turn an ambitious regional strategy into a scaled business.</li> <li>You lead from the front, combining executive presence and strategic thinking with a willingness to engage deeply in customers, opportunities, and execution.</li> <li>You create clarity and accountability while giving talented people the trust, coaching, and support required to perform at their best.</li> <li>You are comfortable making decisions in an environment where demand, customer requirements, capacity, and priorities are evolving rapidly.</li> <li>You build durable customer relationships by combining commercial ambition with technical curiosity, transparency, and consistent follow-through.</li> <li>You think beyond an individual transaction and seek to establish CoreWeave as a long-term strategic partner to the customers and markets you serve.Why CoreWeave?</li> </ul> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:</p> <ul> <li>Be Curious at Your Core</li> <li>Act Like an Owner</li> <li>Empower Employees</li> <li>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</li> <li>Achieve More Together</li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance&nbsp;</li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution&nbsp;</li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary&nbsp;</li> <li>Critical Illness Cover&nbsp;</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme&nbsp;</li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.</em></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Recruitment Agencies</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em><em data-stringify-type="italic">CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms &amp; Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.</em></em></span></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em data-stringify-type="italic">Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party.</em></span></em></p> <p><strong>Export Control Compliance</strong></p> <p><em>This position requires access to technology and/or source code subject to U.S. export control laws. Any such access will be provided only in compliance with applicable U.S. export control requirements. As part of the recruitment process, CoreWeave may request limited information reasonably necessary to assess applicable export-control requirements.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><strong>Updated privacy notice - UK and EU Job Applications&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><em>When you apply to a job on this site, the personal data contained in your application will be collected by CoreWeave UK Ltd. (“Controller”), which is located at</em></p> <p><em>Phosphor (6th Floor), 133 Park Street, London, SE1 9EA</em></p> <p><em>and can be contacted by emailing ----- Controller’s data protection officer can be contacted at ----- Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of managing Controller’s recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes. Such processing is legally permissible under Art. 6(1)(f) of (i) Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation (“GDPR”) and (ii) the GDPR as it forms part of the laws of the UK (“UK GDPR”), as necessary for the purposes of the legitimate interests pursued by the Controller, which are the solicitation, evaluation, and selection of applicants for employment. Your personal data will be shared with Greenhouse Software, Inc., a cloud services provider located in the United States of America and engaged by Controller to help manage its recruitment and hiring process on Controller’s behalf. With respect to transfers originating from the UK or the European Economic Area ("EEA") to a country outside the UK or the EEA, we implement the appropriate transfer mechanism(s) and other appropriate solutions to address cross-border transfers as required by applicable law. You may request a copy of the suitable mechanisms we have in place by contacting us at </em><a ---------- <p><em>Your personal data will be retained by Controller as long as Controller determines it is necessary to evaluate your application for employment. Where permitted by applicable law, we may also retain your personal data for a limited period after the recruitment process ends in order to consider you for future job opportunities, respond to legal claims, or comply with record-keeping obligations. MSF International Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 26 sections, 28 associations and 16 branch offices together. Registered in Switzerland, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF Movement, as well as implements international projects and initiatives as requested. I. CONTEXT MSF consists of 6 Operational Centres (OCs) and 3 European Supply Centres (ESCs). In the supply domain there is a joint Supply Tansformational Topics Roadmap composed by several inter-OC and inter-ESC projects, and their number is growing due to the need to increase cooperation between MSF entities while improving the quality of MSF's supply chain. The capacity to measure performance and analyse data across different entities is therefore essential and is contributing to MSF ambitions on interoperability and climate. The role of the International Office is to foster cooperation and coordination between MSF entities. The Supply Data Analyst will therefore act as a facilitator between the OCs and ESCs: bringing their representatives together, helping them build shared approaches on supply data and performance, and turning these agreements into concrete deliverables. The Global Supply Data & Analytics (GSDA) team (previously SCPM) has been actively working to build the analytical and data foundations needed to support a global approach to supply chain performance management, and to contribute to the governance of supply data across entities. Within GSDA, the Supply Data Analyst will support the growing need for data management, reporting and analytics from the supply chain teams, including the monitoring of KPIs and the analysis of data coming from MSF information systems (such as UniField, Isystock or Akiba). UniField intersection reports are reliable, relevant and meet the needs of the OCs a. Document data sources, definitions and calculation methods 3. KPIs and reporting solutions support decision making a. Calculate and update a set of KPIs on a regular basis, in coordination with the teams concerned b. Build and maintain ad hoc data reporting solutions (Power BI) providing visuals that accurately summarise supply chain activities while providing actionable insights c. Support the teams in the definition of additional KPIs as needs arise 4. Stakeholders receive relevant data analysis and actionable recommendations a. Support stakeholders on supply data analysis b. Present analysis results and recommendations in a clear way to non-technical audiences 5. Cooperation between the OCs and ESCs on supply data produces concrete deliverables a. Convene and facilitate working groups and meetings with representatives of each OC and ESC, from preparation (agenda, pre-alignment of positions) to follow-up (minutes, actions, deadlines) b. Lead discussions between entities with different needs and practices, and build compromises and consensus on shared definitions, KPIs and ways of working c. Turn agreements into concrete deliverables (e.g., shared KPI definitions, dashboards, documentation) and follow their delivery 6. Data-related tools and processes improve continuously and stakeholders are kept informed a. Contribute to the improvement of data-related tools and processes within the team b. Proactively identify data needs, risks and improvement opportunities, and propose solutions autonomously c. Manage stakeholders and expectations: identify their needs, keep them informed, and escalate blockers to the Supply Chain Analytics Manager when needed IV. AUTONOMY, COMPLEXITY Challenges and decisions that the job faces to achieve the accountabilities: Autonomy to think and act: works with limited supervision; takes initiative, prioritises and drives work to completion, proactively identifies data needs, risks and improvement opportunities, and escalates blockers to the Supply Chain Analytics Manager when needed. Complexity of the environment: works across 6 OCs and 3 ESCs with different needs, practices and information systems (UniField, Isystock, Akiba); builds compromises on shared definitions and KPIs, handles multiple priorities at once, and interacts with technical and non-technical stakeholders (finance, IT, medical, pharmacy, logistics, operations) in a cross-cultural and cross-functional environment. SAFEGUARDING REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ROLE The incumbent commits to contribute to a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct. They will not engage in any form of abuse including those detailed in MSF Typologies of Abuse and when an employee suspects or observes abuse, they will report it (without investigating it) to protect others. Education Bachelor's level or above in data analytics, statistics, business management, supply chain or a related field, or a combination of relevant education and professional experience (essential) Experience Minimum of 2 years of experience as Data Analyst (essential) Direct work experience involving significant data management (essential) Experience in facilitating meetings or working groups involving multiple stakeholders and in delivering concrete outputs from them (essential) Supply chain, logistics and Finance experience in NGO's operational settings (desirable) Previous work experience with UniField, MSF's main ERP software (desirable) Skills Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills: ability to bring together representatives of different entities, lead effective meetings, negotiate compromises and deliver concrete outcomes Strong analytical skills Good organisational skills, ability to handle multiple priorities at one time Autonomous and proactive: ability to take initiative, prioritise and drive work to completion with limited supervision Good level skills in Excel, Power BI and database management Ability to work in a cross-cultural and cross-functional environment Drive for change, improvement and innovation Languages Fluent spoken and written English (essential) Good command of French (strongly desirable) Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. title: Offre de stage de recherche Master 2 ou dernière année d’école d’ingénieur
description: Dates : 6 mois à partir de février ou mars 2027 Contexte du projet : L’allègement des structures automobiles reste un levier majeur pour réduire la consommation et les émissions des véhicules, tout en répondant à des exigences croissantes de rigidité et de tenue au crash. Les pièces de caisse en blanc sont en grande majorité réalisées à partir de tôles d’acier mises en forme, dont la conception repose encore largement sur l’expertise et sur des itérations successives entre calcul et dessin. L’optimisation topologique permet de déterminer la meilleure répartition de matière dans un domaine de conception donné. Appliquée à un domaine volumique 3D, elle conduit cependant à des structures massives ou de type treillis, difficilement transposables en pièces embouties d’épaisseur quasi constante. Le défi scientifique consiste à formuler une méthode capable de faire émerger, à partir d’un domaine volumique, des géométries représentatives de tôles (structures à parois minces), en maîtrisant l’épaisseur et la fabricabilité, sous chargements statiques puis dynamiques. Ce stage s’inscrit dans le cadre d’une collaboration de recherche entre le LTDS et ArcelorMittal Global R&D. Il a vocation à se poursuivre par une thèse CIFRE en cas de résultats concluants. L’objectif du stage sera de développer et d’évaluer une première méthodologie d’optimisation topologique 3D aboutissant à une solution en tôle d’acier, en s’appuyant sur une structure automobile. Les missions pourront comprendre : •Un état de l’art des méthodes d’optimisation topologique conduisant à des structures minces de type coque (contrôle d’épaisseur par filtrage et projection, contraintes de longueur caractéristique, approches par composants explicites ou level-set). •Le développement d’un algorithme d’optimisation 3D appliqué à une pièce automobile soumise à des chargements statiques. •L’extension de la méthode à des solutions plus avancées proposées par ArcelorMittal. Les missions pourront être adaptées en fonction du profil du candidat et de l’avancement du projet. Profil recherché : étudiant(e) en Master 2 ou équivalent (stage ingénieur) dans le domaine de la mécanique numérique, du calcul des structures ou des mathématiques appliquées. Compétences souhaitées : méthode des éléments finis, optimisation numérique, programmation scientifique (Python, MATLAB ou C++). Des connaissances en optimisation topologique ou en dynamique rapide (LS-DYNA, Radioss) seront appréciées. Encadrement : Frédéric Gillot (LTDS, École Centrale de Lyon) ; Daoming Yu, Alexandre Blaise et Cristian Alvarez (ArcelorMittal Global R&D). L’accueil au laboratoire est soumis à une autorisation préalable (procédure FSD, 2 à 3 mois de délai) : les candidatures (CV, lettre de motivation, relevés de notes) sont à adresser dès que possible. description: Contexte du rôle Le ou la Team Lead Solution Consulting est responsable de l’organisation, de la performance et du développement de l’équipe de Solution Consultants. L’équipe intervient auprès des clients Pennylane sur la dimension fonctionnelle de projets en cours : analyse des besoins, cadrage, mise en œuvre, formation et adoption du produit. Veiller à l’engagement, à la motivation et à la dynamique collective. title: Chief of Staff Tech - Engineering
description: Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)? Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy? Then Pennylane is the right place for you ! Our vision We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones). We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business. About us Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!) In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to : 💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants 💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more... 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor . 🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe 🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings 🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France! In 2024, we implemented an organizational structure built around business 'tracks'. This approach integrates key stakeholders across marketing, sales, product, and customer care into unified teams focused on specific product lines or client segments. Each track operates as a mini-business, empowered with dedicated resources (e.g., product marketing, data analytics, and operational support) and direct accountability for performance. Why this role matters at Pennylane As Chief of Staff to the CTO, you operate as a senior leader in the Tech organisation. Your leverage does not come from managing teams but from owning the hardest problems that sit between them, and from being technical enough to earn the trust of the other engineering leaders. You are the person the CTO trusts with ambiguous, org-wide problems. You turn that ambiguity into a clear framing, a decision, an owner and a measurable outcome. This is not a coordination role. You are expected to have opinions on engineering strategy, staffing choices and technical trade-offs, and to defend them in front of the Tech leadership team. Team and Context Pennylane's Tech organisation is 70+ squads, each led by an Engineering Manager working with a PM and a Product Designer. We serve 1.5m+ customers and we want to scale in Europe. At that size, the hard problems are no longer inside a squad: how the organisation plans, how it decides, how it measures itself, how it invests in foundations without stalling product delivery. That is your perimeter. You report directly to Quentin, Co-founder & CTO. Your influence comes from the scope of what you own and from credibility with senior engineering leaders, which is why we ask for a technical background. As the organisation grows, this role can evolve towards a management position. Key missions Engineering strategy and transversal initiatives Own the strategic, cross-organization initiatives that no single squad can carry: platform or architecture programmes, reliability and quality step-changes, engineering productivity, technical debt paydown Frame the problem, build the technical and business case, secure alignment across Engineering, Product and Security to drive execution Lead the Tech side of company-level programmes (e.g. European expansion, major compliance or infrastructure shifts) alongside the rest of the Tech leadership Planning & Performance tracking Own the Tech planning cycle: collect the inputs, surface the trade-offs (capacity vs. platform, run vs. new bets), and drive the arbitration with Tech leadership Drive the definition and calibration of Tech OKRs, and hold the organisation accountable Define what "good" looks like for a 70+ squad engineering organization and build the metrics that measure it (delivery cadence, reliability, quality, staffing and attrition, engineering satisfaction) Decision-making and leadership cadence Own the Tech leadership operating system: staff meetings, QBRs, roadmap and architecture reviews. You design them, set the agenda, write or commission the pre-reads, frame the decisions to be made, and make sure decisions land Maintain the CTO's decision log: what was decided, by whom, with what trade-off, and what happened next Raise the quality of decision-making across the Tech leadership team Communication Lead internal and operational communications across the engineering organization, building clear messaging systems from board decks down to team-wide updates Who you’ll work with? CTO and Tech leadership (Head of Engineering / Head of Data / Senior Engineering Managers) Rest of the leadership (CPO, VP Strategic Initiatives) Other relevant teams (e.g. Security, Finance, People) Who we’re looking for Must-have An engineering degree (engineering, computer science or equivalent scientific curriculum) Technical fluency: you can read a design doc, follow an architecture discussion, challenge an estimate or a trade-off, and be taken seriously by senior engineers 7-10 years of experience, including significant time inside a tech organisation at scale (multiple squads, platform teams), where you have lived the problems of scaling engineering A track record of owning complex, cross-organisational initiatives from framing to measurable outcome with senior stakeholders Outstanding written communication: this role produces documents that senior people act on Fluency in English Nice-to-have A hands-on engineering past: software engineer, engineering manager, Technical Program Manager, architect or equivalent Experience as a Chief of Staff, VP/Director of Engineering Operations, or in a strategy & operations function inside a product-led tech company What you can expect? Within one month You'll complete the company and Tech onboarding, including our application, accounting domain and engineering practices You'll have met the Tech leadership team and formed your own view of where the organisation loses time, quality or alignment You'll have taken ownership of the leadership cadence and the next planning milestone Within 3-6 months You'll be leading selected org-wide strategic initiatives end-to-end, with a measurable target The Tech organisation will have a metrics picture it trusts and uses to make decisions You'll be a recognised voice in the senior tech community at Pennylane, consulted on decisions rather than just informed of them You'll be shaping the engineering narrative that the rest of the company and the board hear Recruitment Process - Screening interview with Barbara - Senior Recruiter (30 mins) - An interview with Eric - VP Strategic Initiatives (45 mins) - An interview with Quentin - CTO (1h) - A Business Case to prepare at home and to present (1h) - A final interview with Nathan - Head of Product Strat&Ops (45 mins) What do we do to make your work life easier 🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane 💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package 📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us 🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it ⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness 🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French 💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment 🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone 🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone. If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…) We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries. Who are we looking for ? To thrive at Pennylane, you need : -To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to) -To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment -To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders) -Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria. If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration. raw.title: Chief of Staff Tech - Engineering
raw.description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

 

In 2024, we implemented an organizational structure built around business 'tracks'. This approach integrates key stakeholders across marketing, sales, product, and customer care into unified teams focused on specific product lines or client segments. Each track operates as a mini-business, empowered with dedicated resources (e.g., product marketing, data analytics, and operational support) and direct accountability for performance.

 
 

Why this role matters at Pennylane

 

As Chief of Staff to the CTO, you operate as a senior leader in the Tech organisation. Your leverage does not come from managing teams but from owning the hardest problems that sit between them, and from being technical enough to earn the trust of the other engineering leaders.

You are the person the CTO trusts with ambiguous, org-wide problems. You turn that ambiguity into a clear framing, a decision, an owner and a measurable outcome.

This is not a coordination role. You are expected to have opinions on engineering strategy, staffing choices and technical trade-offs, and to defend them in front of the Tech leadership team.

 

Team and Context

Pennylane's Tech organisation is 70+ squads, each led by an Engineering Manager working with a PM and a Product Designer. We serve 1.5m+ customers and we want to scale in Europe. At that size, the hard problems are no longer inside a squad: how the organisation plans, how it decides, how it measures itself, how it invests in foundations without stalling product delivery. That is your perimeter.

You report directly to Quentin, Co-founder & CTO. Your influence comes from the scope of what you own and from credibility with senior engineering leaders, which is why we ask for a technical background. As the organisation grows, this role can evolve towards a management position.

Key missions

Engineering strategy and transversal initiatives

  • Own the strategic, cross-organization initiatives that no single squad can carry: platform or architecture programmes, reliability and quality step-changes, engineering productivity, technical debt paydown

  • Frame the problem, build the technical and business case, secure alignment across Engineering, Product and Security to drive execution

  • Lead the Tech side of company-level programmes (e.g. European expansion, major compliance or infrastructure shifts) alongside the rest of the Tech leadership

Planning & Performance tracking

  • Own the Tech planning cycle: collect the inputs, surface the trade-offs (capacity vs. platform, run vs. new bets), and drive the arbitration with Tech leadership

  • Drive the definition and calibration of Tech OKRs, and hold the organisation accountable

  • Define what "good" looks like for a 70+ squad engineering organization and build the metrics that measure it (delivery cadence, reliability, quality, staffing and attrition, engineering satisfaction)

Decision-making and leadership cadence

  • Own the Tech leadership operating system: staff meetings, QBRs, roadmap and architecture reviews. You design them, set the agenda, write or commission the pre-reads, frame the decisions to be made, and make sure decisions land

  • Maintain the CTO's decision log: what was decided, by whom, with what trade-off, and what happened next

  • Raise the quality of decision-making across the Tech leadership team

Communication

  • Lead internal and operational communications across the engineering organization, building clear messaging systems from board decks down to team-wide updates

Who you’ll work with?

  • CTO and Tech leadership (Head of Engineering / Head of Data / Senior Engineering Managers)

  • Rest of the leadership (CPO, VP Strategic Initiatives)

  • Other relevant teams (e.g. Security, Finance, People)

Who we’re looking for

Must-have

  • An engineering degree (engineering, computer science or equivalent scientific curriculum)

  • Technical fluency: you can read a design doc, follow an architecture discussion, challenge an estimate or a trade-off, and be taken seriously by senior engineers

  • 7-10 years of experience, including significant time inside a tech organisation at scale (multiple squads, platform teams), where you have lived the problems of scaling engineering

  • A track record of owning complex, cross-organisational initiatives from framing to measurable outcome with senior stakeholders

  • Outstanding written communication: this role produces documents that senior people act on

  • Fluency in English

Nice-to-have

  • A hands-on engineering past: software engineer, engineering manager, Technical Program Manager, architect or equivalent

  • Experience as a Chief of Staff, VP/Director of Engineering Operations, or in a strategy & operations function inside a product-led tech company

What you can expect?

Within one month

  • You'll complete the company and Tech onboarding, including our application, accounting domain and engineering practices

  • You'll have met the Tech leadership team and formed your own view of where the organisation loses time, quality or alignment

  • You'll have taken ownership of the leadership cadence and the next planning milestone

Within 3-6 months

  • You'll be leading selected org-wide strategic initiatives end-to-end, with a measurable target

  • The Tech organisation will have a metrics picture it trusts and uses to make decisions

  • You'll be a recognised voice in the senior tech community at Pennylane, consulted on decisions rather than just informed of them

  • You'll be shaping the engineering narrative that the rest of the company and the board hear

Recruitment Process

- Screening interview with Barbara - Senior Recruiter (30 mins)

- An interview with Eric - VP Strategic Initiatives (45 mins)

- An interview with Quentin - CTO (1h)

- A Business Case to prepare at home and to present (1h)

- A final interview with Nathan - Head of Product Strat&Ops (45 mins)

What do we do to make your work life easier

 

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

-To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

-To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

-Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains ----- or ----- style="min-height:1.5em">We will never ask you for payment or financial information

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

 

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Notre data policy

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. title: CDI - Senior AI Engineer - Paris
description: <h2>Mission</h2> <p>De nouveaux modèles, ouverts ou fermés, sortent chaque mois : encore faut-il choisir ceux qui sont assez bons pour la production, et le démontrer. Applications et agents s’appuient sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM), et la partie modèle de ces systèmes est entre vos mains. Nos clients s’en servent pour répondre à leurs propres clients, traiter des documents et interroger leurs connaissances.</p> <p>Ce que le modèle voit, la manière dont il retrouve les connaissances, les outils qu’il peut appeler : ces choix vous appartiennent, de même que la mesure de la qualité des réponses. Le modèle retenu doit tenir l’objectif de coût et de qualité.</p> <p><strong>Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez savoir si un système d’IA donne des réponses justes, et pas seulement s’il tourne.</strong></p> <p>Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype AI Engineer.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Activités et responsabilités</h2> <p>Les Product Engineers construisent l’application autour du modèle ; le comportement du modèle à l’intérieur vous revient. Les Context &amp; Analytics Engineers préparent les connaissances que vos agents retrouvent, et les Platform Engineers exploitent le serving, le harness et l’observabilité sur lesquels vous vous appuyez.</p> <p>Avec l’AI Product Manager et les experts métier du client, une bonne réponse se définit, puis les résultats s’examinent ensemble. La relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues font partie du quotidien.</p> <p><strong>Vos responsabilités :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Construire des applications et des agents LLM : conception du contexte, appel d’outils, workflows multi-étapes.</li> <li>Concevoir la façon dont les agents exploitent les connaissances : requêtes de retrieval, re-ranking, citations.</li> <li>Construire des jeux et des pipelines d’évaluation : réponses de référence, scoring automatisé, relecture par des experts métier.</li> <li>Suivre la qualité des réponses en production et corriger ce qui se dégrade.</li> <li>Choisir les modèles selon la qualité, le coût et la latence ; faire du fine-tuning ou de la distillation sur un modèle plus petit quand le prompting ne suffit pas.</li> <li>Ajouter des garde-fous contre les mauvaises réponses, les fuites de données et le prompt injection.</li> <li>Traiter des documents avec des LLM : extraction, classification, résumés.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Profil recherché</h2> <p><strong>Les indispensables :</strong></p> <ol> <li>Vous avez construit une application ou un agent qui appelle un LLM, et vous savez expliquer ce qui a fonctionné et ce qui a échoué.</li> <li>Votre code est testé et maintenable.</li> <li>Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.</li> <li>La qualité des sorties d’IA se mesure chez vous avec des jeux de test et des métriques, et vous savez limiter les hallucinations, le prompt injection et les fuites de données.</li> <li>Mettre en production une application LLM et la maintenir (déploiement, monitoring, coût, latence) n’a pas de secret pour vous.</li> <li>Le point de départ, pour vous, est le problème métier plutôt que le modèle ; reconnaître que l’IA n’est pas toujours le bon outil, et l’expliquer à des personnes non techniques, fait partie de votre pratique.</li> </ol> <p><strong>Un plus, pas un prérequis :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Du fine-tuning ou de la distillation de modèles de langage.</li> <li>Une formation en machine learning ou en statistiques, par exemple en data science.</li> <li>Des frameworks ou des protocoles d’agents, comme MCP.</li> <li>Des entrées multimodales : documents, images, voix.</li> <li>Des outils d’observabilité LLM : tracing, suivi des coûts.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler</strong> : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?</h2> <p>Dans ce métier, la difficulté est moins de faire parler un modèle que de savoir s’il dit juste. L’AI Engineer répond à cette question par la mesure : jeux de test, évaluations, suivi en production, plutôt que par l’impression d’une démonstration réussie.</p> <p>Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.</p> <p>Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.</p> <p>Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.</p> <p>Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.</p> <p>Le reste s’approfondit sur les projets : évaluation, conception d’agents, adaptation de modèles, avec l’appui de la communauté AI Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype AI Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (responsabilité en production, bases de la sécurité de l’IA).</p> <p>Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme les chapters AI Architect et AI Product Manager.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Processus de recrutement</h2> <p>Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.</p> <ol> <li><strong>Entretien RH</strong> (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.</li> <li><strong>Appel avec le CTO</strong> (15 à 30 min, à distance).</li> <li><strong>Screening technique</strong> (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.</li> <li><strong>Code review et live coding</strong> (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.</li> <li><strong>Cas technique</strong> (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.</li> <li><strong>Entretien final</strong> (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.</li> </ol> <p>Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Les Context &amp; Analytics Engineers préparent les connaissances que vos agents retrouvent, et les Platform Engineers exploitent le serving, le harness et l’observabilité sur lesquels vous vous appuyez.</p> <p>Avec l’AI Product Manager et les experts métier du client, une bonne réponse se définit, puis les résultats s’examinent ensemble. faire du fine-tuning ou de la distillation sur un modèle plus petit quand le prompting ne suffit pas.</li> <li>Ajouter des garde-fous contre les mauvaises réponses, les fuites de données et le prompt injection.</li> <li>Traiter des documents avec des LLM : extraction, classification, résumés.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Profil recherché</h2> <p><strong>Les indispensables :</strong></p> <ol> <li>Vous avez construit une application ou un agent qui appelle un LLM, et vous savez expliquer ce qui a fonctionné et ce qui a échoué.</li> <li>Votre code est testé et maintenable.</li> <li>Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.</li> <li>La qualité des sorties d’IA se mesure chez vous avec des jeux de test et des métriques, et vous savez limiter les hallucinations, le prompt injection et les fuites de données.</li> <li>Mettre en production une application LLM et la maintenir (déploiement, monitoring, coût, latence) n’a pas de secret pour vous.</li> <li>Le point de départ, pour vous, est le problème métier plutôt que le modèle ; Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.</p> <p>Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. raw.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Pre-Sales role ⭐️

Our Pre-Sales team strengthens Alan’s Enterprise and Public sector Sales to better handle the specificities of our largest customers.

Here are the main missions of the team you will join:

  • Master our platform and support Sales team by enabling them with insights, expertise and the relevant tools;

  • Listen and understand prospects’ needs and work internally on how Alan can address them best;

  • Build a thorough understanding of the prospect and assess the level of functional alignment with our offering and capabilities;

  • Participate to RFP submissions and build Alan’s response in collaboration with Sales, Insurance and Product experts;

  • Join the customer acquisition journey to evangelize our services and products;

  • Act as voice of the customer feeding Alan’s platform roadmap;

  • Prepare handover for delightful customers’ onboardings;

  • Eventually coordinate the most complex customer onboardings leveraging your unique knowledge of the customer’s requirements and specificities.

You will actively participate in developing this growing function within Alan and edit the company to make our Sales teams the most successful of all!

Given the growing need for onsite customer engagement, you are ideally located in Paris or the Île-de-France region (or within a 2-hour door to door distance with the flexibility to travel to Paris on short notice for customer meetings).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-E level range.

⭐️ You will be a great fit if ⭐️

  • You have 6+ years of experience working in a SaaS environment, including at least 3 in a Pre-Sales / Sales Engineering / Solution Consultant role.

  • You have a talent for quickly getting to the root cause of customers concern through active listening and requirements elicitation;

  • You are assertive and know how to handle objections in a complex environment;

  • You master the art of pitching a product with transparency and without overselling its capabilities ;

  • You have the ability to break down complex issues and identify product gaps to define the best product solutions;

  • You thrive at high level stakeholders’ management;

  • You excel at prioritizing tasks while living up to commitments;

  • You love teamwork and are always eager to learn and grow;

  • You are fluent in both French and English;

It would be even better if you have:

  • Experience with end-to-end procurement projects (buyer or supplier side) with involvement in RFI’s, RFQ’s and RFP’s;

  • Experience in the French Public Sector;

  • Experience in HRIS ecosystems and Payroll solutions;

  • Experience in Insurance or Health platforms.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.
