raw.title: (Senior) Recruiter - Growing Impact Scale Up
raw.description:
Join us in Revolutionizing Supply Chains
We’re a fast-growing SaaS scale-up on a mission to shape a sustainable future for the food industry. With four years of continuous 100% year-on-year growth, our team is expanding quickly. We’re looking for a proactive, highly organised Recruiter to help us find the people who will drive that growth, and to help shape how we work as we scale. Join us and shape the future of food sustainability with us!

About Simvia

Ensuring responsible supply chains is one of the largest challenges of our time. At Simvia we are on a path to enable the food and consumer goods industry to become a force for good, by making it simple to prove that what we eat and use is safe, compliant, and sustainable. 

Several of Europe's largest retailers, from Albert Heijn to Edeka, have joined Simvia together with their suppliers, and our network now spans more than 200,000 suppliers in 130 countries. AI gives us a strong tailwind: our network holds unique data, and much of the manual work in compliance can now be automated. We are growing rapidly and keep scaling with a driven, international team of 75+ people in the heart of Amsterdam. 

About this role

You will be our first in-house Recruiter. There is no recruitment playbook yet, so you build it: the process, the guardrails and the habits that let us hire fast and well as we scale. That calls for someone who thinks "I'll find a way" rather than "what's the rule here?" 

Sourcing is the heart of the job. Most of your impact comes from finding and convincing great people who were not looking. Every person you bring in shapes the company we become, so we want someone who lives our culture, not only someone who can describe it. 

Who thrives here

Our culture is driven and kind, and it only works if you bring both. 

Driven by the mission. You set ambitious goals, own the outcome, and welcome a high bar. 

Frank. You say what you think and would rather hear the truth than a comfortable story. 

Open. You ask for feedback and change your mind when the facts change. 

Trusting. You build real relationships and give others room to own their work. 

If this sounds more draining than energizing, that is a useful signal too. 

What you will work on

  • Sourcing and approaching great people across sales, customer success, product and engineering, through LinkedIn, referrals and cold calls, so most of our hires come from you rather than agencies 

  • Building our recruitment process from scratch: clear steps, interview templates and scorecards that every hiring manager follows 

  • Running several hiring processes at once, from role profile to signed offer, with candidates always knowing where they stand 

  • Holding hiring managers, senior leaders included, to agreed timelines and fast feedback 

  • Tracking time to hire, source effectiveness and funnel conversion, and using the numbers to improve how we hire 

  • Helping our People & Culture team with in-house events and office life in quieter hiring periods 

What you bring

  • 3+ years as a recruiter, in-house or agency, with hires across SaaS or tech roles from sales to R&D 

  • Real sourcing strength: direct approach and cold calls give you energy, and you can point to hires you found yourself 

  • A builder's mindset: you enjoy setting up processes, templates and guardrails where none exist yet 

  • Highly organized: you run many roles and steps at once without dropping anything 

  • You enjoy speed, and you are assertive with senior stakeholders while staying warm with candidates 

  • You already use AI and automation in your work and are curious about the next tool

  • Fluent English, written and spoken 

Nice to have

  • German and/or Dutch, German being the most useful 

  • Experience in a start-up or scale-up 

  • Experience with an ATS and LinkedIn Recruiter 

What we offer

  • A high-paced organization with room to grow your career 

  • A meaningful mission: help the food and consumer goods industry become a force for good 

  • Training and support, a pension contribution and travel reimbursement 

  • Fresh lunch every day, monthly Thirsty Thursdays, hackathons, boat parties and our annual dance event 

  • At least three days per week in our Amsterdam city center office, with two rooftop terraces 

How we hire

An intro call with our People & Culture team, a conversation with the hiring manager, an assignment, a culture conversation and an offer. Every process includes an assignment, because we would rather see your work than hear about it. We move fast and keep you informed at every step. 

Diversity & Inclusion at Simvia

We hire people with different backgrounds, cultures, and views because it makes our work better. Whoever you are, wherever you are from, whoever you love and whatever you believe in, you are welcome here. 

 

Questions about this vacancy? Reach out to our People & Culture team at .

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Backend Platform (PHP and Python)
description: WHO WE ARE 🌍 Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does. Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work. We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟 Want to own how the backend works for everyone, not just one corner of it? We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who works across PHP and Python and wants a say in the bigger picture. You’ll lead company-level projects like our Auth Service: one authorization layer for PHP and Python, so Python products can handle their traffic directly instead of going through PHP. When things are unclear, you’ll research first, weigh the trade-offs and write them down. Then you’ll ship in small, safe steps. You’ll also decide where code should live based on what’s best for the system, not on which language you know best. Product teams will come to you for advice, reviews, and a way through when they're stuck. The team is still taking shape, so you'll also help define ownership, standards, and how we work. If that mix of deep technical work and influence across teams sounds like you, keep reading. YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋 Meet the Backend Platform team: We're a small team of engineers from core PHP, Infra, and AI backgrounds. We lead technical initiatives across the whole backend and own its health. Product teams build and run their own components, and we give them the tools, standards, and expertise to do it well. Each of us leads our own project, from planning to agreeing with other teams to production. We work in weekly cycles and write our decisions down. Right now we're bringing PHP and Python platform work together into one common backend platform. WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀 Lead company-level technical projects end to end, from design and planning to rollout and support, such as completing our Auth Service development and shaping authorization as a separate layer for PHP and Python. Shape the shared PHP and Python platform, and decide where each module should live based on the needs of the whole system. Build the foundations that let new Python products launch and scale without being wired through PHP each time. Define clear ownership of technical components across the backend, including who owns monitoring and knowledge for each. Improve how we spot and handle problems: bug and incident management, less noise in alerts and error tracking, and Grafana Cloud dashboards for how services interact. Find root causes across PHP and Python services using metrics, logs, and distributed tracing. Make performance part of everyday work, not something we fix after incidents: clear performance metrics, tools that show where things slow down, and analysis of unusual user behavior that causes degradation. Make architecture decisions with high load in mind, working with databases, servers, proxies, and DNS alongside the Infra team. Work with the Security team to fix vulnerabilities, build in security practices, and keep libraries and dependencies up to date. Improve developer experience: dev environment, CI/CD, routine automation, one documentation approach for PHP and Python, and tools for AI coding assistants. Turn product teams' requests into solutions: find what really hurts, propose the best fix, and support them with architecture advice and reviews in shared components. TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥 You'll need: Production backend experience in PHP or Python, and the ability to read and work with the other. You'll write production code in both. Experience with high-load production systems and improving their performance. Experience designing multi-component systems with clear boundaries, planning for failures, rollout, and rollback, with security in mind. Experience comparing technical options, naming the trade-offs, and explaining your choice in writing (ADRs, Design Docs). Hands-on observability experience: metrics, dashboards, alerts, logs, and distributed tracing, and using them to find root causes. Experience leading a project that spans several teams: breaking it into small, testable steps, getting other teams on board, and taking it to production. A track record of improving engineering quality beyond your own tasks, for example setting up error monitoring, or a new process when things kept breaking. Enough infrastructure knowledge (databases, servers, proxies, DNS) to work well with Infra and see how your changes affect them. Clear communication: you explain your point of view, find the real problem behind a request, and flag risks early. Experience leading work independently while supporting your team: taking feedback, helping colleagues grow, and changing your mind when the arguments are good. It would be great if you have: Experience on a Platform or Core team. Strong production experience in both PHP and Python. Experience with authentication and authorization systems (for example, JWT or Ory Oathkeeper). Experience defining SLOs and building symptom-based alerts. Experience running incidents and blameless post-mortems. Experience with Grafana Cloud, Rollbar, or similar tools. Experience building developer tooling, CI/CD, or tools for AI coding assistants. Experience mentoring engineers or leading knowledge sharing across teams. WHAT WE OFFER 🤗 We care deeply about your growth, well-being, and comfort: 🌍 Hybrid onboarding to start work remotely and relocation support for you and your family. 💙 Comprehensive health insurance for both you and your family. 📚 Professional development budget for conference tickets, online courses, and other relevant resources to help you grow. 🫶 Flexible benefits package: no one-size-fits-all perks here. You get a budget and you decide where it goes, from health and wellbeing to family and setting up your home office. 🪴 Hybrid work and generous, flexible time off — planned with your team, not rationed by a rigid quota. 🍽️ In-office perks, including free meals and snacks. 🤝 Company-funded sport activities, annual offsites and team-building events. 🤖 AI isn't a perk here — it's how we work. Claude, OpenAI, and more are on by default from day one, and we back teams in adopting whatever makes them faster. Manychat is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual preference, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance. This commitment is also reflected through our candidate experience. description: BlockTech is hiring a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join its Tech department in Amsterdam. Crypto markets never close, and neither does our trading. Bare-metal hosts, cloud instances, exchange connectivity, messaging, and the trading services on top all have to work around the clock. In this role, you'll sit between infrastructure, engineering, and trading, and follow every problem wherever it leads. We specialize in market making and trade cryptocurrency derivatives and spot markets globally, using our own capital. We're growing fast and expanding into new markets. You will make sure everything works, and works properly. Most problems don't stay inside one team's boundaries: a strange fill might come from a network issue, a config change, or an exchange that changed its behavior without telling anyone. You understand what each service does for trading, what it costs when it breaks, and which fix matters most right now. You own an issue from the first alert to the long-term fix that stops it coming back. You will: Own the live environment. Monitor trading across all our venues, take charge of incidents, and own both the immediate fix and the long-term one. Bridge infrastructure, engineering, and trading. Translate a trader's “something looks off” into a root cause, and a root cause into a priority the right team can act on. Partner with the desk. Work closely with traders and quants, so reliability work is driven by what actually matters for PnL and risk. Debug across the full stack. Linux and network performance, exchange connectivity, messaging and databases (Kafka, NATS, Redis, PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB, ClickHouse), and the Python and Rust trading services themselves. Own our hybrid infrastructure. Run the bare-metal fleet and cloud deployments, plus their configuration management and deployment pipelines across environments. Build observability. Use Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, Sentry, and Kibana to catch a problem before the trading desk does. Change things safely. Plan and run maintenance, upgrades, and releases without trading going dark. Raise the bar. Cut toil with automation, and spread SRE practices across Tech so every team builds reliable systems from the start. What we're looking for You'll need: 5+ years running production systems where uptime and correctness matter, in an SRE, DevOps, systems, or software engineering role. At least 2 years of that in a trading environment (a trading firm, exchange, or broker), working directly with live trading systems and traders. A working understanding of how trading systems operate: order and quote flow, positions and PnL, exchange connectivity, and why latency and correctness matter. A commercial mindset. You can weigh technical trade-offs against business impact and explain them clearly to traders and engineers alike. Strong Linux skills, including troubleshooting performance at the OS and kernel level. Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, UDP, and multicast, plus comfort reading a packet capture. Hands-on experience running production workloads in a public cloud (AWS or similar): networking (VPCs, peering, cross-region latency), compute choices, and infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar). Proficiency in Python, and the ability to read and debug code you didn't write, including our Rust services. Hands-on experience with configuration management (Ansible or similar) and CI/CD. Experience operating at least some of our stack: Kafka, NATS, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, Prometheus, or Grafana. Calm, structured incident handling, and clear communication in English under pressure. Bonus points for: Experience with options or crypto markets. Exchange connectivity experience (WebSocket or FIX APIs). Low-latency or market-making environments. Hands-on Rust experience. Much of our platform is written in it. Network hardware (Arista, Cisco), routing protocols, or packet capture tooling. Server hardware and kernel tuning for low latency. Running data-heavy systems such as time-series databases. You'll own hard problems from the first alert to the long-term fix and solve them your way. We invest in our people by offering competitive compensation and benefits, fostering innovation, and celebrating success. title: Sr. Engineering Manager
description: About myTomorrows myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business. Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. The Opportunity: Senior Engineering Manager As an Engineering Manager at myTomorrows, you will lead Backend, Frontend, Full Stack and QA engineers building the platforms that help patients find their treatment options. Our Expanded Access Program (EAP) platform and Clinical Trials (CT) platform connect patients and healthcare professionals with treatments in development and give our BioPharma Partners the tools to run their programs and trials. You’ll shape how these platforms grow, building a high-performing team that ships well-designed, scalable, secure and compliant software, and delivers it on time. You won’t do it alone. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, EAP and CT Operations, and our Platform colleagues in DevOps, Security and Data. Together, you’ll turn ambitious company goals into product outcomes that make a real difference in patients’ lives. Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance of our office in Amsterdam. What you’ll do in this role: Lead, mentor and manage a team of Backend, Frontend, Full Stack and QA engineers. Foster a collaborative, inclusive and high-performing culture. Own engineering delivery for your areas of the EAP and CT platforms, from discovery through to release and operation in production. Partner with Product Managers and Designers to shape the roadmap, refine priorities, and plan and execute features and improvements. Provide technical leadership in architecture and design, ensuring solutions are robust, maintainable, scalable and secure. Work with engineers on decisions about tools, frameworks and approaches. Champion engineering best practices: proactive exploration AI-enabled and agentic development, code quality, testing, code review, API design, observability, documentation and secure development. Ensure quality and compliance requirements are built into how the team works. This includes data privacy and the regulatory context of healthcare. Build a culture of ownership, experimentation and continuous improvement, including healthy team rituals and retrospectives. Partner with Recruitment to attract, hire and onboard top talent. What you bring to the table: A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 6+ years of experience in software engineering, with a solid background in backend, frontend or full stack development. 5+ years of experience leading or managing engineering teams. A proven track record of delivering high-quality web products and developing engineers. Hands-on familiarity with modern backend and frontend technologies. Experience with Python and Angular is a plus. A strong understanding of Agile ways of working, product development and engineering best practices. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally and influence stakeholders at all levels. A passion for working in a mission-driven organisation focused on improving patient outcomes. Experience in a regulated domain such as healthcare or life sciences or in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, is a plus. What success looks like in the first 6 months: You’ve built trust within your team and with Product, Design and Operations, and established clear ownership across your areas of the EAP and CT platforms. Delivery is predictable and transparent. The team ships valuable increments regularly, with a clear link to product goals. Code quality, test coverage and release reliability are visibly improving. Every team member has clear expectations and a development plan, and you’ve addressed any key gaps in team composition. The team works with autonomy and accountability, and collaborates well with Platform and other engineering teams. You’ve identified and started executing key technical or organisational improvements that enhance scalability and team effectiveness. You’re seen as a trusted technical and people leader, balancing strategic direction with hands-on support where needed. Our current tech stack: We are fully cloud-native on AWS. We follow a lean, API-first product development approach. Our platform services, both microservices and AI, are built in Python. Our frontends are built with Angular. We use GitHub Actions for CI/CD to EKS and Terraform for IaC, with staging/production parity, continuous deployment and Grafana for observability. Security is built in through managed secrets, SSO, dependency scanning, end-to-end encryption and periodic pen-tests. Equal opportunities myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Senior Account Executive - Benelux
raw.description:
Help fix customer-centricity at scale


Every company wants to become more customer-centric. At TheyDo, we make that ambition real. Our AI-powered journey management platform helps the world’s largest enterprises align around what matters most: their customers. By bringing scattered data and teams together, we empower smarter decisions and better experiences. Since 2019, global leaders across industries — including Ford, Cisco, Johnson & Johnson, Siemens, Home Depot, and Lufthansa — have trusted us to scale journey management and deliver measurable impact.

Backed by $50M from top-tier investors, including Blossom and 20VC, we are building a category-defining company. Our fully remote team of 100+ TheyDoers represents 30+ nationalities across 27 countries, united by a customer-led, people-first culture.

Our mission is clear: Make journey management the most powerful business tool in the world.

If you’re looking for a place where your work shapes the future of how companies operate, join us. Let’s build it together.

The role

Journey management is becoming a must-have for the world's biggest companies, and TheyDo is the platform leading the category. Enterprises like Ford, Cisco, Vodafone and Pfizer already use TheyDo to understand their customers end to end and decide where to act.

Now we're going after the rest of Europes biggest brands, and we want you leading the charge. As a Senior Account Executive, you'll take a greenfield territory of enterprise accounts, open the doors, and land the new logos that define TheyDo's next chapter.

You'll be based in the Benelux, working remotely and reporting to Stephan. You'll join a team of 6 EU AEs, backed by SDR, Enablement and Customer Success colleagues across North America and Europe.

Why this role, now

The timing couldn't be better. Customer experience has moved into the boardroom, and enterprises want a way to turn it into decisions. TheyDo gives them that, and our customers are proving it.

Europe is wide open. Your target list is full of companies that look just like the ones already buying from us, and most of them have never had a TheyDo conversation. We know what wins. Now we need someone to scale it and put their name on the logos that come next.

This is the moment to join: early enough to shape how we win, with the proof that we do.

What you'll do

This is a role built around creating revenue that didn't exist before, not managing revenue that already does.

Build your own pipeline. You'll start from a target list, not a book.

  • Own a named list of Benelux enterprise accounts and decide where to focus, based on signal rather than hope

  • Source most of your pipeline yourself through outbound, account-based plays with BDR and Marketing, events and executive networking

  • Break into accounts with no existing relationship and find the senior person who owns the customer experience problem


Win the first deal. You'll take a cold account all the way to signature.

  • Run complex, multi-stakeholder cycles from first conversation through discovery, business case, procurement and close

  • Sell on value to C-level and VP buyers across CX, Product and Digital: a business case a CFO will sign, not a feature tour

  • Land mid-to-high six-figure first deals, structured to expand, and hand them to Customer Success with the context to grow them

Shape how we win. You'll help write the European playbook.

  • Refine our ICP, messaging and sales motion based on what you see in the field

  • Share buyer insight with Product so they can act on it

  • Forecast accurately and keep the team informed through clear async updates

What this role isn't

We'd rather be clear now than have the wrong person find out six months in.

  • It isn't account management. You won't inherit renewals or an installed base to upsell. If most of your number has come from growing existing customers, this probably isn't your role.

  • It isn't inbound-led. Marketing and SDR will support you, but you'll be expected to create most of your own pipeline.

  • It isn't a finished machine. If you need fully built enablement, years of territory data and a playbook that tells you what to do next, you'll find this frustrating. If you want to help build those things, you'll find it energizing.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years closing B2B SaaS deals, with most of that in enterprise new-business roles selling into enterprise organizations.

  • A track record of exceeding annual quotas, where the majority of your closed revenue came from net-new logos you sourced yourself. Be ready to walk us through the numbers.

  • Proven ability to land mid-to-high six-figure first deals with enterprises that weren't customers before.

  • Experience selling a platform or new-category product, where you had to create the need rather than respond to an RFP.

  • A value-selling methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or similar) you actually use, not just know.

  • Confidence engaging C-level buyers, building consensus across stakeholders and navigating enterprise procurement, security and legal

  • You'd rather start with a blank target list than a handed-over book, and you're energized by a scale-up where the product and playbook move fast

Bonus points if you have experience selling to CX, Product, Digital or Design leaders

What we offer our permanent employees:

💰 Competitive compensation and pre-IPO equity - we like to give our team members ownership with our stock package. When TheyDo succeeds, we all succeed!

🌍 Fully remote working with flexible hours - we're staunch advocates for autonomy and flexibility.

🩺 Health Insurance benefit - at TheyDo our team’s health and wellbeing are a priority. We include tailored support for every employee, regardless of location.

🌴 Flexible holiday days – We love what we do and equally love taking a break. You'll have a minimum of 25 days of paid holiday per year (pro rata), in addition to public holidays and an extra three days during our annual company-wide winter shutdown in December.

🧠 Learning and Development budget we encourage everyone to take ownership and invest in their growth and development, providing financial support to benefit you in your role and career.

🧘‍♂️Wellbeing budget - nurture your mind and body. We’ll support you in looking after you, whether it's meditation, mindfulness, or a yoga/gym membership.

👪 Paid parental leave - we'll ensure financial support and time off for you to bond with the newest little members of your family (6 months for the primary carer, and 6 weeks for the secondary carer - fully paid). We provide paid childcare leave when you need to take time out to help your little one recover.

👨‍💻Home office or co-working support - choose your ideal workspace with our home office or co-working budget. Whether you prefer the comfort of your home office or the collaborative atmosphere of a co-working space, we've got you covered.

🗺️ Company events - we regularly connect in-person to strategise, reflect or simply have fun. Our most recent company retreats were held in Spain, Portugal and France.

⚒️ Latest tech & tools - MacBook Air or Pro, we want you to have the equipment that you’re most comfortable with. We use tools such as Gather, Slack, Notion, Loom, G:Suite and naturally TheyDo to work collaboratively and asynchronously.

🚀 Continuous growth of our benefits package as we continue to grow in size

To any recruitment agencies, we appreciate you would like to support us but we do not accept any unsolicited CVs or introductions.

About TheyDo

Our core values are the driving force behind every decision we make.

We ‘Journey together’ along a path of collaboration and synchronization. In everything we do, we ‘Own it’, never shying away from taking action or making decisions. Our ‘Cloaks off’ mentality ensures that transparency and integrity reign supreme. We ‘Simply to accelerate', cutting through complexity to focus on what truly matters and moving forward with clarity and speed Moreover, ‘Customer Fueled’ innovation is at the heart of our work, as we know that the success of our product is directly linked to how we involve our customers in the process.

TheyDo is an equal opportunities employer. Our customers are diverse, and we believe our organisation should be, too. We nurture an inclusive culture where everyone feels equally important, no matter their background or status. We will never discriminate on the grounds of gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education, or race.

Our commitment to building a diverse and inclusive TheyDo includes making reasonable adjustments to the interview process. If you need any adjustments, please reach out to your Talent Partner.

If you are a woman or part of an underrepresented group, we encourage you to apply. Even if you don’t check every box — your skills and perspective could be just what we need to succeed. We value diversity and know you bring something unique to the table!

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Our Purpose<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.</p> <h3>About Us<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.</p> <p>Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.</p> <h3><strong>What Are We Looking For?</strong></h3> <p>We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.</p></div><p>As a Senior Sales Operations Manager, you will support the EMEA South Go-To-Market team as a trusted advisor to sales leaders, enabling consistent, predictable, and repeatable hyper-growth through sales discipline, streamlined processes, and a strong operating cadence. You will partner with the EMEA South Leadership Team on GTM design, business analysis, and metrics while managing the day-to-day rhythm of the business, with field productivity as your north star. This role is based in Amsterdam, Prague, or Milan, and is ideal for someone who wants to be an active voice driving change rather than a passive spectator.</p> <h3>What Will You Do?</h3> <p>Primary responsibilities include:</p> <ul> <li>Serve as the EMEA South Operations Lead and trusted advisor to key sales leaders, actively participating in the EMEA forecasting process, advising on changing pipeline dynamics, and challenging forecasts to ensure accuracy, predictability, and transparency.</li> <li>Manage Area business metrics including performance, trends, headcount, and investment models, and lead the development of key sales metrics and business review materials, monitoring performance and taking action to optimize business results.</li> <li>Drive the annual sales planning process, including Area, Regional, and District goal assignments, territory management updates, and sales compensation plan changes.</li> <li>Identify gaps in the infrastructure needed to support Sales and develop solutions, with a strong focus on AI, that align to the team’s overall vision, while educating and training teams on key sales processes.</li> <li>Act as an active voice that drives change with Area leadership, and align with the Global Revenue Operations team to represent the needs of the field.</li> </ul> <h3>What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?</h3> <p>Ideal candidates will have:</p> <ul> <li>7 to 10 years of experience in Sales, Revenue, or Field Operations supporting sales teams, with a strong emphasis on enabling teams to be hyper-productive, ideally within organizations selling subscription security software.</li> <li>Experience designing and scaling processes that support a hyper-growth business model, including documenting key processes in a publicly traded environment.</li> <li>Proven analytical ability to turn disparate datasets into insightful analytics, including developing messaging, data visualizations, and executive-level presentations.</li> <li>Solid experience with a key tech stack including Salesforce, Clari, Tableau, MS Office, G-Suite, and AI tools.</li> <li>Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence sales teams, build collaborative relationships across functions, and translate the complex needs of the field. A Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Management, Technology, or Economics is required, and an MBA is a plus.</li> </ul> <h3>Why SentinelOne?</h3> <p>AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.</p> <p>We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:</p> <p><strong>Equity &amp; Rewards</strong></p> <ul> <li>Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)</li> <li>Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off &amp; Wellbeing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive leave benefits</li> <li>Gender-neutral parental leave</li> </ul> <p><strong>Insurance &amp; Financial Security</strong></p> <ul> <li>Insurance and medical allowance</li> <li>Pension scheme</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program (EAP)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Work Perks &amp; Flexibility</strong></p> <ul> <li>Global home office allowance</li> <li>Mobile phone reimbursement</li> <li>Commuter or work-from-home allowance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wellness &amp; Lifestyle</strong></p> <ul> <li>Wellness benefit</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles.&nbsp;</span></p> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">To learn more about how we use AI in our hiring process, please review our&nbsp;<a href="https://assets.contentstack.io/v3/assets/blt53c99b43892c2378/bltca86b3b84e902400/AI-in-Hiring-SentinelOne.pdf">AI in Hiring Candidate Disclosure</a>.</p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Daarbij combineer je strategisch inzicht met commerciële scherpte en daadkracht. Bij voorkeur in een zakelijke of kennisintensieve B2B-omgeving; aantoonbare ervaring met het adviseren van directies en businessverantwoordelijken en het vertalen van organisatiedoelstellingen naar een resultaatgerichte marketingcommunicatieaanpak; ervaring met het coördineren van multidisciplinaire werkzaamheden en het projectmatig aansturen van interne specialisten en externe partners. Met goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, veel flexibiliteit en volop mogelijkheden om je te ontwikkelen.  Een sterk fundament Een goede basis begint bij voorwaarden waarop je kunt rekenen: een salaris tussen € 6.500 en € 7.500 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur; een flexibele pot van minimaal 15% van je jaarsalaris, inclusief vakantiegeld; een goede pensioenregeling bij Zwitserleven, waarbij Movares twee derde van de pensioenpremie betaalt; een NS Business Card voor woon-werkverkeer en zakelijke reizen. Privé profiteer je met de kaart van de dalurenkorting. Maximaal flexibel Vorm een manier van werken die aansluit bij jouw leven én jouw ambities. Maak keuzes die bij jou passen: flexibel werken volgens ons Any Time Any Place-principe, passend bij je team, klanten en projecten; de mogelijkheid om twee weken per jaar te werken vanaf je vakantieadres binnen de EU; 20 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen te kopen vanuit je flexibele pot; met je flexibele pot kies je wat voor jou belangrijk is, bijvoorbeeld voor extra inkomen, pensioen, een fiets, bedrijfsfitness, verduurzaming van je woning of het aflossen van je studieschuld; € 750 budget per vijf jaar om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten; € 2,45 netto thuiswerkvergoeding per thuiswerkdag. Veel ontwikkelmogelijkheden Ontwikkel een loopbaan die past bij jouw talenten en ambities. Kies jouw eigen pad: ruimte om je expertise, ambitie en loopbaan verder te ontwikkelen; leren door te doen, samen met ervaren collega's en met gebruik van een breed aanbod aan ontwikkelmogelijkheden; de kans om actief kennis te delen en mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van ons vakgebied. Samen groeien Deel mee in de waarde die we samen creëren en de groei van onze organisatie. Samen voor succes: je flexibele pot groeit mee met de resultaten van Movares; een winstdeling met een doelbedrag van 5% van je bruto jaarsalaris, afhankelijk van de resultaten; en de mogelijkheid tot participeren in de waardeontwikkeling van Movares door middel van aankoop van phantom aandelen. Jouw team bij Movares Je wordt onderdeel van het team Marketing & Communicatie, dat momenteel bestaat uit veertien vakspecialisten. Het team is volop in ontwikkeling, er gebeurt veel, de lijnen zijn kort en niet alles ligt al vast. Dat geeft jou de ruimte om initiatief te nemen, nieuwe ideeën uit te proberen en zichtbaar bij te dragen aan de manier waarop Movares zich intern en extern presenteert. Je werkt nauw samen met communicatieadviseurs, marketeers, recruiters, collega’s uit de verschillende businessonderdelen. Zij kennen de projecten en inhoud, jij helpt om relevante en aantrekkelijke verhalen in de markt te zetten. Binnen het team vind je gedreven aanpakkers die kennis delen, van elkaar leren en ook tijd maken om samen te lunchen of een wandeling te maken. Op maandag en donderdag werk je met het team in Utrecht. Op andere dagen rouleren we tussen verschillende Movares-locaties en thuis. title: Backend Software Developer
description: Backend Software Developer – Maatwerk Software met Impact Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Binnen onze Smart Devices afdeling bouwen we apps die impact maken. Van media apps voor bedrijven als Pathé en de NPO met miljoenen gebruikers, tot de app van het KNMI waarmee we belangrijke weerswaarschuwingen zoals code rood meldingen afgeven. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details. Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Backend Software Developer . Iemand die energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van sterke backend-omgevingen, het schrijven van strakke code en het operationeel krijgen én houden van de onderliggende cloud-infrastructuur voor applicaties met miljoenen gebruikers. Jouw rol Als Backend Software Developer ben je een onmisbare schakel in de backend-trajecten van onze applicaties. Je bouwt de schaalbare, onzichtbare motor achter hoogwaardige innovaties en zorgt dat onze infrastructuur robuust staat. Je bent analytisch sterk en je krijgt er energie van om technische requirements te vertalen naar logische cloud-infrastructuren die je vervolgens zélf bouwt. Je werkt nauw samen met onze multidisciplinaire ontwikkelteams en zorgt dat de code soepel draait. Geen haastwerk, maar engineering met diepgang en visie. Wat je zal gaan doen: Ontwikkelen en operationeel maken van serverless backends en event-driven API's met TypeScript (AWS Lambda / Serverless Functions). Zelfstandig opzetten van cloud-infrastructuren met behulp van Infrastructure as Code (bijv. via AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation). Proactief meedenken over en het inrichten van CI/CD pipelines, applicatie-uptime en databeveiliging. Bijdragen aan de codekwaliteit door middel van code reviews en het actief delen van kennis met jouw teamleden. Effectief asynchroon samenwerken, documenteren en code opleveren binnen een distributed, remote-first team. Wie ben jij? We zoeken een developer met een HBO werk- en denkniveau die al de nodige stappen heeft gezet in het bouwen van cloud-native applicaties . Je hebt sterke ervaring met de TypeScript/Node.js stack en modern software-development zoals Agile/Scrum, CI/CD en Infrastructure as Code kent voor jou geen geheimen. Je bent niet alleen een developer, maar je kunt ook écht zelf cloudomgevingen operationeel krijgen en beheren met tools als AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation . Algemene cloud kennis is een vereiste; specifieke ervaring met AWS of Scaleway is een pre . Je geniet van technische puzzels, levert graag goed geteste code op en voelt je thuis in een Node.js backend. Verder ben je woonachtig in Nederland . Wat bieden wij jou? De Organisatie : Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software. Autonomie : Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie. Maatschappelijke Impact : De kans om bij te dragen aan bekende, maatschappelijk relevante applicaties voor platformen zoals NPO Start, Pathé Thuis en het KNMI binnen een uitstekend beoordeeld top-tier maatwerk softwarebedrijf (Emerce100 koploper). Salaris : Bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4000,- en €6000,- passend bij jouw ervaring. Vakantiedagen : 25 vakantiedagen om lekker uit te rusten. Werkplek & Sfeer : Een fijne remote-first cultuur met volledige flexibiliteit, een gezellige werksfeer en inspirerende maandelijkse co-working dagen. Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken : Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding, gecombineerd met een maandelijkse thuiswerkvergoeding. Pensioen : Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen. Ontwikkeling & Extra's : Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen, plus actieve deelname en toegang tot het eigen event Appdevcon en diverse kennissessies. De 'Gadget Kit' : Een high-end MacBook Pro, een 27 inch 5K display, testdevices en een volledig ingerichte thuiswerkplek. Events & Fun : Toffe teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events. Over Dawn Technology We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er écht toe doen – van zorg en educatie tot duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dát maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend. Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis, zoeken we de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken we elkaar. Benieuwd om te horen hoe het is om bij Dawn Technology te werken? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast . Solliciteren Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Ook als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren. Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360 . Have a great day. Dawn Technology. We gebruiken voor nieuwe kandidaten een assessment (actueel binnen software ontwikkeling) om het niveau objectief vast te stellen. Hiermee onderbouwen we de totstandkoming van het salaris in het recruitmentproces op basis van feitelijke vaardigheden. Dit geeft ons een eerlijk en meetbaar kader voor iedereen. title: Interim Senior Community Manager
description: Who we are We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves.   With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another.   Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth.   We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands. We’re on the search for... Someone who has built a community for a brand before, and who can bring ours to life online and offline. Since 1959, Interrail has been more than a rail pass. We’re now building it into a cultural movement, and our community is where that movement becomes real: the deeper you travel through Europe, the more the journey changes you, told by the people who lived it. In 2027 our community moves into the Interrail app and website. Our product and technical team builds the platform. You make it a community: you shape the community vision, bring the first members in, and create the moments, online and in real life, that make travellers come back and help each other. The Brand team shapes what Interrail stands for and how it shows up wherever travellers meet us. We own our brand platform and positioning, and our community, bringing The Interrail Effect to life through the people who’ve travelled with us. We work closely with Product, Social & Community, Creative & Content, CRM, and the PR & Partnerships teams to keep every touchpoint consistent and culturally sharp. This is a nine-month interim contract. The team meets in the office a minimum of twice per week, so you’ll be required to join those days to work alongside your colleagues.   What you’ll be doing You’ll be part of the Brand team, reporting to the Brand Lead who owns the Community Program. You’ll lead the community from launch to a community that’s live, safe, well populated and growing, online and offline. The community isn’t a loyalty scheme or a fan club. It’s where travellers tell the truth about their journeys, inspire others and help the next person go and experience it. You’ll work closely with Product (Social Connection and Loyalty team), Customer Experience, Legal and Privacy, PR & Partnerships, Social, and our Creator Partnerships and Creative colleagues. You’ll be: Shaping the community vision, values and member code with the Brand Lead, and laying the foundations for Interrail as a cultural movement, online and offline. Building the community strategy: who we bring in first, which journeys launch first and how the community grows after launch. Bringing our existing members across as founding voices, and working with Content and Marketing to onboard our Pioneers. Launching the first community rituals, and making the community a source of real traveller stories for the brand. Designing and running a first pilot of real-world moments, such as gatherings at stations or partner places, with PR & Partnerships and Social. Building good relationships with the independent Interrail communities on Facebook, Reddit and beyond. We partner with them; we never try to replace them. Keeping the community safe: setting guidelines, the moderation approach with Customer Experience, and working with Legal, Privacy, and Safety so nothing goes live until it’s signed off. Being the members’ voice in our Product team, measuring community health with Analytics and CRM, and creating a playbook so what you build lasts. What we’re looking for Here’s what will help you in this role. If you don’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you. 8+ years building communities for brands, including at least one you grew from launch. Experience running community both online and in real life, such as events, meet-ups or ambassador programs. You have written a community vision or strategy and turned it into a plan that others follow. A track record of building early momentum, so people join and champion the community, not just follow it. Experience setting moderation and safety policies, and comfort working with Legal and Privacy on consent, safeguarding and GDPR. A clear point of view on what makes a community healthy, and the confidence to defend it with product teams. Organised, good at documenting and comfortable working across many teams, so what you build outlasts your contract. A genuine interest in train travel, meeting locals, new experiences and other cultures. Bonus points for experience with community platforms or social SDKs, multilingual moderation, or a long rail trip through Europe of your own.    Curious to apply? Apply directly through our careers page .   We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through. For some roles, we may also ask you to complete a short task based on the real job, so you can show us your skills in practice.   If we’d like to get to know you better, the next step is a first conversation with Talent Acquisition, followed by interviews with the team. It’s a two-way conversation: a chance for you to explore Interrail, and for us to get to know you.   To keep our hiring fair, we use blind screening in the early stages. Your name, photo, date of birth, gender, nationality, contact details and social media links are hidden, so our first decisions are based only on your skills, experience and potential.   In the meantime If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a sense of our culture and values?   Got questions? Our team would be happy to help: just drop us a note at   While you’re here, you can plan your own trip and find your Pass at www.interrail.com . Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

You’ll work closely with Product (Social Connection and Loyalty team), Customer Experience, Legal and Privacy, PR & Partnerships, Social, and our Creator Partnerships and Creative colleagues.

You’ll be:

  • Shaping the community vision, values and member code with the Brand Lead, and laying the foundations for Interrail as a cultural movement, online and offline.

  • Building the community strategy: who we bring in first, which journeys launch first and how the community grows after launch.

  • Bringing our existing members across as founding voices, and working with Content and Marketing to onboard our Pioneers.

  • Launching the first community rituals, and making the community a source of real traveller stories for the brand.

  • Designing and running a first pilot of real-world moments, such as gatherings at stations or partner places, with PR & Partnerships and Social.

  • Building good relationships with the independent Interrail communities on Facebook, Reddit and beyond. We partner with them; we never try to replace them.

  • Keeping the community safe: setting guidelines, the moderation approach with Customer Experience, and working with Legal, Privacy, and Safety so nothing goes live until it’s signed off.

  • Being the members’ voice in our Product team, measuring community health with Analytics and CRM, and creating a playbook so what you build lasts.

What we’re looking for

Here’s what will help you in this role. If you don’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you.

  • 8+ years building communities for brands, including at least one you grew from launch.

  • Experience running community both online and in real life, such as events, meet-ups or ambassador programs.

  • You have written a community vision or strategy and turned it into a plan that others follow.

  • A track record of building early momentum, so people join and champion the community, not just follow it.

  • Experience setting moderation and safety policies, and comfort working with Legal and Privacy on consent, safeguarding and GDPR.

  • A clear point of view on what makes a community healthy, and the confidence to defend it with product teams.

  • Organised, good at documenting and comfortable working across many teams, so what you build outlasts your contract.

  • A genuine interest in train travel, meeting locals, new experiences and other cultures.

Bonus points for experience with community platforms or social SDKs, multilingual moderation, or a long rail trip through Europe of your own.

  

Curious to apply?

Apply directly through our careers page.

 

  • We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through.

  • For some roles, we may also ask you to complete a short task based on the real job, so you can show us your skills in practice.

 

If we’d like to get to know you better, the next step is a first conversation with Talent Acquisition, followed by interviews with the team. It’s a two-way conversation: a chance for you to explore Interrail, and for us to get to know you.

 

To keep our hiring fair, we use blind screening in the early stages. Your name, photo, date of birth, gender, nationality, contact details and social media links are hidden, so our first decisions are based only on your skills, experience and potential.

 

In the meantime

If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a sense of our culture and values?

 

Got questions? Our team would be happy to help: just drop us a note at

 

While you’re here, you can plan your own trip and find your Pass at www.interrail.com.

description: We're on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing. With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we're Europe's largest student rental platform. You'll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors. As an Engineering Manager at HousingAnywhere, you will play a critical role in leading the evolution of our platform with your vision. You will join the Product Engineering team, leading one of our product teams that owns a key part of the renter journey, from finding and applying to booking, moving in and staying. You will collaborate closely with other product teams and departments, from Sales to Marketing to Customer Support, serving both internal and external customers. We expect you to lead and enable your team to deliver effectively, setting the right technical direction while leveraging the talent present in your team. While we expect you to be technical, your focus will be on strategy and leadership rather than heavy hands-on coding. AI is changing how we build software, and we are going all in. You will lead a team that uses AI in its daily work, from writing and reviewing code to planning, testing and decision-making. We expect you to be a hands-on practitioner who uses these tools yourself and pushes your team to get the most out of them. Our Tech Stack At the Backend we mostly use Go, Postgres, and Redis. At the Frontend we use React, Typescript, and NodeJs. Our infrastructure runs on GCP, and we are heavy users of Kubernetes. Our Architecture is a distributed architecture made of several "Modular Monoliths". We practise DevOps, Continuous Delivery, Domain Driven Design, and Contract Driven Development.   Your role In your daily role, your impact will be defined by key pillars: Delivery, Direction, Talent, and Culture. Delivery : Lead your team to scope and plan projects, identifying bottlenecks and improving processes. You will ensure engineering standards are held high and remove impediments to provide a smooth developer experience.  Direction : Create alignment and a sense of urgency through well-crafted strategies and goals. You will direct your team to relate their work to organizational goals and provide a clear sense of purpose. Talent : Nurture talent with regular feedback and performance reviews, supporting career growth. You will identify skill gaps and execute hiring strategies to acquire top talent. Culture : Lead by example to foster ownership, empowerment, and autonomy. You will promote a growth mindset, value diverse perspectives, and address problems to maintain a healthy team culture. Craft : Equip your team to solve problems with pragmatic, sustainable solutions. You will foster engineering excellence, support knowledge-sharing, and keep the team up to date with the latest technical trends. AI-first engineering : Make AI a core part of how your team works, not an experiment on the side. You will drive adoption of AI-assisted development and review, define what good practice looks like, and measure the effect on delivery speed and quality. You will keep the team's standards high while the way of working changes.   Your profile 3 years minimum of experience in the field managing a team, focused on building and maintaining complex domains and distributed architectures. Strong recent experience in managing high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams. Strong knowledge in Distributed Systems and Domain Driven Design. Ability to set technical direction without getting bogged down in heavy hands-on work. Real, recent experience using AI tools in your own day-to-day work and getting your team to do the same. For us AI is central to how we deliver, so if you see it as a nice-to-have, this role is not the right fit.   What's in it for you Unlimited paid holidays, minimum-based not maximum! Position based in our Rotterdam office with hybrid working policy (2 office days). Flexibility to work remotely for up to 2 months per year! 1,000 EUR personal development budget. Complete coverage for commuting. Personal equipment, including laptop and ergonomic setup. Gym membership discount with Wellhub. Dutch/English classes budget. Variable pension scheme. Diverse international community (46+ nationalities). Pet-friendly office in Rotterdam city centre.  Team-building events and after-work drinks every Friday. We're on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing.

With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we're Europe's largest student rental platform. You'll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors.

As an Engineering Manager at HousingAnywhere, you will play a critical role in leading the evolution of our platform with your vision. You will join the Product Engineering team, leading one of our product teams that owns a key part of the renter journey, from finding and applying to booking, moving in and staying. You will collaborate closely with other product teams and departments, from Sales to Marketing to Customer Support, serving both internal and external customers.

We expect you to lead and enable your team to deliver effectively, setting the right technical direction while leveraging the talent present in your team. While we expect you to be technical, your focus will be on strategy and leadership rather than heavy hands-on coding. AI is changing how we build software, and we are going all in. You will lead a team that uses AI in its daily work, from writing and reviewing code to planning, testing and decision-making. We expect you to be a hands-on practitioner who uses these tools yourself and pushes your team to get the most out of them.

Our Tech Stack

At the Backend we mostly use Go, Postgres, and Redis. At the Frontend we use React, Typescript, and NodeJs. Our infrastructure runs on GCP, and we are heavy users of Kubernetes. Our Architecture is a distributed architecture made of several "Modular Monoliths". We practise DevOps, Continuous Delivery, Domain Driven Design, and Contract Driven Development.

 

Your role

In your daily role, your impact will be defined by key pillars: Delivery, Direction, Talent, and Culture.

  • Delivery: Lead your team to scope and plan projects, identifying bottlenecks and improving processes. You will ensure engineering standards are held high and remove impediments to provide a smooth developer experience. 
  • Direction: Create alignment and a sense of urgency through well-crafted strategies and goals. You will direct your team to relate their work to organizational goals and provide a clear sense of purpose.
  • Talent: Nurture talent with regular feedback and performance reviews, supporting career growth. You will identify skill gaps and execute hiring strategies to acquire top talent.
  • Culture: Lead by example to foster ownership, empowerment, and autonomy. You will promote a growth mindset, value diverse perspectives, and address problems to maintain a healthy team culture.
  • Craft: Equip your team to solve problems with pragmatic, sustainable solutions. You will foster engineering excellence, support knowledge-sharing, and keep the team up to date with the latest technical trends.
  • AI-first engineering: Make AI a core part of how your team works, not an experiment on the side. You will drive adoption of AI-assisted development and review, define what good practice looks like, and measure the effect on delivery speed and quality. You will keep the team's standards high while the way of working changes.

 

Your profile

  • 3 years minimum of experience in the field managing a team, focused on building and maintaining complex domains and distributed architectures.
  • Strong recent experience in managing high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams.
  • Strong knowledge in Distributed Systems and Domain Driven Design.
  • Ability to set technical direction without getting bogged down in heavy hands-on work.
  • Real, recent experience using AI tools in your own day-to-day work and getting your team to do the same. For us AI is central to how we deliver, so if you see it as a nice-to-have, this role is not the right fit.

 

What's in it for you

  • Unlimited paid holidays, minimum-based not maximum!
  • Position based in our Rotterdam office with hybrid working policy (2 office days).
  • Flexibility to work remotely for up to 2 months per year!
  • 1,000 EUR personal development budget.
  • Complete coverage for commuting.
  • Personal equipment, including laptop and ergonomic setup.
  • Gym membership discount with Wellhub.
  • Dutch/English classes budget.
  • Variable pension scheme.
  • Diverse international community (46+ nationalities).
  • Pet-friendly office in Rotterdam city centre. 
  • Team-building events and after-work drinks every Friday.

title: Working Student - Procurement

Our goal is 1,000 stations in prime locations. About the role We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Working Student with a strong passion for data, analytics and procurement . In this role, you will play a key part and help build the foundations of Procurement at Fastned. In this role, you will be part of the Procurement Team, reporting to the Head of Procurement and collaborating closely with the Finance, Legal, and cross-functional teams spanning Construction, Operations, Technology & Engineering, and IT. Procurement at Fastned is designed to support the business, not constrain it. The Procurement function does not make unilateral decisions about supplier or product selection. Instead, it brings structure, market insight, commercial expertise and oversight. You will help put this approach into practice. You’re excited about Fastned’s mission and eager to play an active part in accelerating the energy transition. Real responsibility from day one . At Fastned, we don't believe in busywork. We want you to think like a founder! Your input matters, and you'll be expected to take ownership. Your analyses will influence where Fastned builds next. An hourly salary of €16,25 gross (+ holiday pay) . Apply today! We would love to hear from you! 📍Location: Amsterdam

⏱ Weekly Hours: Between 16 -30 hours per week

📅 Start Date & Duration: Available immediately (6-month minimum commitment)

Join Fastned at the forefront of Europe’s electric vehicle and charging infrastructure revolution! Since 2012, Fastned has been building and operating a rapidly growing network of iconic fast-charging stations powered entirely by solar and wind energy — now spanning over 400 stations across nine countries in Europe. Our goal is 1,000 stations in prime locations.

About the role

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Working Student with a strong passion for data, analytics and procurement . In this role, you will play a key part and help build the foundations of Procurement at Fastned.

In this role, you will be part of the Procurement Team, reporting to the Head of Procurement and collaborating closely with the Finance, Legal, and cross-functional teams spanning Construction, Operations, Technology & Engineering, and IT.

Procurement at Fastned is designed to support the business, not constrain it. The Procurement function does not make unilateral decisions about supplier or product selection. Instead, it brings structure, market insight, commercial expertise and oversight. You will help put this approach into practice.

What you’ll be doing

  • Dive into our supplier and purchasing data to uncover spending patterns, spot smart consolidation opportunities, and identify potential savings.

  • Research market developments, map out supplier landscapes, and benchmark pricing and services across Fastned’s key procurement categories.

  • Help set the team up for success in commercial negotiations by preparing clear supplier profiles, spend insights, and negotiation briefs.

  • Keep track of how our suppliers are performing across cost, quality, delivery, and ESG—helping prepare supplier reviews and following up on agreed next steps.

  • Help build and maintain practical procurement templates, guidelines, and sourcing documentation that make buying at Fastned smooth and transparent.

  • Support our Procurement Champions across different teams by sharing handy tools, templates, and everyday guidance.

  • Coordinate meetings and workshops with internal teams and suppliers, making sure decisions and follow-up actions are clearly captured.

Who we are looking for

  • You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s programme (ideally in Business, Economics, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field) with a genuine interest in procurement, supplier management, or commercial negotiations.

  • You enjoy diving into data, spreadsheets, and complex information to turn them into clear, actionable insights. You’re confident with Excel and PowerPoint, and experience with data visualisation or procurement tools is a great plus.

  • You take initiative, ask thoughtful questions, and work well independently, while handling sensitive commercial and financial information with discretion.

  • You communicate clearly and enjoy partnering with stakeholders across different teams and backgrounds.

  • Fluency in English is essential, and any additional European language is a bonus.

  • You’re excited about Fastned’s mission and eager to play an active part in accelerating the energy transition.

What you’ll learn

In this role, you will gain practical experience in:

  • Procurement category management and strategic sourcing

  • Supplier and contract management

  • Spend analysis, RFP and tender processes

  • Commercial negotiations

  • Procurement governance and stakeholder management

  • Building a new Procurement function in a fast-growing international company


What you get out of it

Beyond a meaningful working student role at a company actively accelerating Europe's energy transition, here's what we offer:

  • Flexibility that fits your schedule. We'll coordinate your working hours around your studies, no forced trade-offs between work and university.

  • Daily lunches, snacks and drinks at our Amsterdam office.

  • Break a sweat and improve your well-being with our Urban Sports Club Subscription and additional weekly fitness classes (kickboxing & bootcamp) led by professional trainers.

  • Mental Wellbeing with nilo health: Access to a confidential mental health platform offering 1-on-1 coaching with psychologists, group sessions, and a variety of digital self-care tools.

  • Real responsibility from day one. At Fastned, we don't believe in busywork. We want you to think like a founder! Your input matters, and you'll be expected to take ownership. Your analyses will influence where Fastned builds next.

  • An hourly salary of €16,25 gross (+ holiday pay).

Apply today!

We would love to hear from you! Send us your CV along with a short motivation explaining why you're excited about joining our mission.

Fastned stands for equity and inclusion. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, gender identities, sexual orientations, religions, neurodiversity, disabilities, parental status or any other protected characteristic that makes you unique.

title: Platform Engineer - Data Resilience and Recovery platform
description: <p>Build and own a self-service, multi-tenant platform that keeps the critical data of 20+ customers recoverable<br><br>Do you like building platforms that other teams consume, at scale, across private and public clouds, with security and tenant isolation as non-negotiables? At Schuberg Philis, the world is shifting from traditional backup to data security and resilience. We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to strengthen our Data Management-as-a-Service (DMS) team and help us build the next generation of our platform.<br><br>About the Team<br><br>The DMS team builds and runs a shared, fully segregated data resilience platform that serves more than 20 of our customers. Customer teams consume it through self-service, and they handle their own day-to-day backup and restore operations. That means you won’t spend your days on job monitoring, restore tickets or backup schedules. Your customers are internal and external engineering teams, and your product is the platform they build on.<br><br>You’ll join a dedicated group of data security experts within our larger Services Team and work closely with our sbp.cloud team, who operate our self-built sovereign cloud solutions. With our plan-build-run approach, you take end-to-end ownership: you design it, you build it, you run it.<br><br>The Challenge<br><br>Running one platform for 20+ customers means solving the hard problems of platform engineering:</p> <ul> <li>Multi-tenancy by design: strict isolation of data, access, and performance between customers, on shared infrastructure.</li> <li>Self-service at scale: APIs, guardrails and automation that let customer teams onboard and operate independently, without tickets.</li> <li>Scale and resilience: 4,000+ protected endpoints and more than 25,000 recovery points generated daily, on a dedicated private cloud spanning multiple availability zones.</li> <li>Heterogeneous workloads: Oracle, MS-SQL, SAP, Sybase, PaaS, container platforms and VMs across VMware VCF, OpenStack, AWS, Azure and Kubernetes.</li> <li>Modern storage back-ends: public cloud services and S3-compatible object storage built on Pure FlashBlade//S and NetApp StorageGRID in our own datacenters, plus a long-term archiving tier.</li> <li>Security first: immutability, segregation and hardening in a highly secure environment where recoverability is the ultimate guarantee.</li> </ul> <p>Your Role<br><br>As a Platform Engineer, you take full responsibility for the lifecycle of the platform: architecture, deployment, evolution and reliability. You treat the platform as a product: you improve features, drive innovation and keep the user experience of customer teams in mind. You work closely with technology vendors (primarily Commvault) and push their product teams to improve, while applying standardized guardrails, driving automation and following best-in-class practices.<br><br>Your focus is on making day-2 operations simple and cost-effective, so there is room to implement new security features, streamline customer onboarding and enable new projects. You also guide customers in their data protection needs, contribute to RFIs/RFPs, and help scope and design new solutions.<br><br>What You’ll Do</p> <ul> <li>Own the architecture and lifecycle of a multi-tenant data resilience platform, in line with our plan-build-run methodology.</li> <li>Design and ship self-service capabilities that customer teams use independently, end to end.</li> <li>Automate everything repeatable: deployments, tenant onboarding, configuration and platform operations, using Infrastructure as Code.</li> <li>Ensure platform availability, aiming for 100% uptime and maximum customer satisfaction.</li> <li>Evolve a diverse storage back-end across public cloud and on-prem S3-compatible solutions.</li> <li>Enable customers to protect workloads on VMware VCF, OpenStack, AWS, Azure, Kubernetes and more.</li> <li>Work with vendor product teams and drive their roadmaps.</li> <li>Provide hands-on advisory and technical support, contribute to RFI/RFP processes, and help design new solutions.</li> </ul> <p>Who Are You?</p> <ul> <li>First and foremost, you are a platform engineer at heart, and you like building things other engineers rely on. A passion for data protection, security and resilience is a plus, and you’ll grow it here.</li> <li>You enjoy teamwork, thrive on challenges and like collaborating with both peers and customers.</li> <li>You’re comfortable in highly secure, complex environments.</li> <li>You have a solid understanding of multi-tenant architectures and security concepts.</li> <li>You are proficient in Linux and/or Windows ecosystems.</li> <li>You have experience across private (VMware/OpenStack) and public cloud platforms (Azure, AWS).</li> <li>You’re skilled in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible and/or Chef) and in scripting and automation (Python, Bash, PowerShell, etc.).</li> <li>Experience with data management/protection tools is valuable, whether Commvault, Rubrik or similar, but not a must. We’ll teach you the domain; you bring the engineering craft.</li> </ul> <p>More information?<br><br>Do not hesitate to call Maggie: 06 23 75 70 86.</p> <p><em>Only application submitted through the website will be considered.&nbsp;</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>Everyone we work with and consider working with has a right to equal treatment. The hiring and appraisal process at Schuberg Philis is designed to be thorough and equitable, implementing fair payment, benefits, and opportunities across all demographics.&nbsp;</em><br><em>&nbsp;</em><br><em>It is our desire to be a company that brings together multiple nationalities, cultures, religions, genders, abilities, and talents within and across our teams. We welcome colleagues from diverse backgrounds to join Schuberg Philis and actively support diversity and inclusion in the tech industry.</em></p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid, ruimte om mee te denken en de kans om zichtbaar impact te maken op de groei van Change. Waar ben je verantwoordelijk voor? Actieve sourcing en hunting Je zoekt actief naar commercieel talent via LinkedIn, jobboards en netwerken. Je weet latent werkzoekenden te vinden en te enthousiasmeren voor Change.
